text.en:
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Building (Strata Management) (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2005 and shall come into operation on 1st April 2005.
[S 620/2025 wef 01/10/2025]

2. The following offences may be compounded by the Commissioner of Buildings in accordance with section 131(1) of the Act:
(a)an offence (other than a continuing offence) under section 14, 16(4), 17(9) or (10), 18(2), 20(8), 26(9), 27(4), 28(4), 48(1A) or (3), 120(2), 126(6)(b) or (c) or 134(4) of the Act;
[S 783/2018 wef 01/02/2019]
[S 620/2025 wef 01/10/2025]
(aa)an offence under section 6(5) or 9(1) of the Act as in force before 1 October 2025;
[S 620/2025 wef 01/10/2025]
(b)an offence under regulation 9(3) or 10(5) or (6) of the Building Maintenance (Strata Management) Regulations 2005 (G.N. No. S 192/2005); and
(c)any offence under the Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Lift, Escalator and Building Maintenance) Regulations 2016 (G.N. No. S 348/2016) as in force before 1 October 2025.
[S 421/2016 wef 08/09/2016]
[S 620/2025 wef 01/10/2025]
